name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for damaged-board replacement?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for damaged-board replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor, look for experience in damaged-board replacement, positive local references, and proper licensing and insurance. A good contractor should provide a clear, detailed estimate and openly communicate about the repair process, materials, and timeline. Prioritize quality workmanship and reliability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for experience, local references, proper licensing, clear estimates, and good communication when choosing a contractor.
